business.description: Gokul Refoils and Solvent Limited is engaged in the manufacturing, processing, and refining of castor oil and its value-added derivatives through its subsidiary Gokul Agri International Limited. The company also deals with related parties engaged in manufacturing, formulation, trading, and export of organic products including bio-fertilisers, manures, and agricultural or industrial chemicals.

outlook.statement: The Company anticipates improved returns in the near future.

The Indian edible oil industry is expected to witness steady growth supported by rising population, increasing disposable incomes, urbanization, changing food consumption patterns, and growing consumer awareness regarding health, nutrition, and food safety driving demand for branded, fortified, and value-added edible oils. Government's focus on enhancing domestic oilseed production through NMEO-Oilseeds is expected to strengthen domestic edible oil ecosystem. Increasing demand from food processing, hospitality, and quick-service restaurant sectors is expected to support industry growth. Outlook for castor oil and organic fertilizer businesses remains positive due to growing global emphasis on sustainability, renewable resources, and bio-based products driving demand for castor oil derivatives across specialty chemicals, pharmaceuticals, personal care, lubricants, and industrial applications. Increasing focus on sustainable agriculture, soil health management, and organic farming practices is expected to support growth in organic fertilizer segment.

The Company remains optimistic about the long-term prospects of its businesses with improving domestic economic environment, supportive government initiatives, growing consumer demand, and increasing focus on sustainability.

Strategic emphasis will continue on enhancing procurement efficiencies, optimizing supply chain operations, improving manufacturing productivity, strengthening export presence, expanding retail and distribution networks, and increasing contribution of value-added products across business segments.

The Company is currently carrying out an internal evaluation to restructure its compensation templates and assess the precise financial impact of the new labour codes. The financial impact, if any, will be quantified and recognized in the financial statements of the period in which the rules are fully implemented and the definitive compliance dates become operational.

The Group is currently carrying out an internal evaluation to restructure its compensation templates and assess the precise financial impact of the new labour codes (Code on Wages 2019, Code on Social Security 2020, Industrial Relations Code 2020, Occupational Safety Health and Working Conditions Code 2020). The financial impact, if any, will be quantified and recognized in the financial statements of the period in which the rules are fully implemented and the definitive compliance dates become operational.
